primary.title: RBI fixed deposit rules changes: Could this impact FD interest rates for customers? We explain…
primary.summary: RBI has allowed banks to offer differential interest rates on bulk deposits based on their liquidity risk under the Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) framework. We explain how this impacts customers and if this could affect your fixed deposit rates with banks…
